titles: The Vampire Dies in No Time
เจ้าแวมไพร์ พันธุ์ตายไว

source.description: Draluc is an immortal higher vampire from the prestigious Dragon Clan who keeps dying and turning to dust from all kinds of small things. As his castle was destroyed, he moved in with Ronaldo, much to the other's dismay. Draluc is a typical-looking adult vampire with pale and boney complexion, pointy ears and nose. He has round lazy eyes, short black hair that is combed backwards.

A vampire hunter in his 20s with a base of operations in Shin-Yokohama. Originally not thrilled to have [Draluc](https://anilist.co/character/195177/Draluc) as a roommate, the success of the partnership in his novel series, _The Ronaldo Chronicles_, leads him to reluctantly put up with the vampire. He frequently kills Draluc when annoyed. He also has an extreme phobia of celery.

John is a male armadillo and a familiar of [Draluc](https://anilist.co/character/195177/Draluc). He understands human language, but is unable to speak. As only Draluc can understand him, John uses gestures and signs to communicate with others. He gained immortality after officially becoming Draluc's familiar.

An officer from the Vampire Control Division. She's the youngest Vice Captain in the Division's history. She wields dual blades while on duty. While she presents as firm and strict, she's easily flustered. She loves [Draluc](https://anilist.co/character/195177/Draluc)'s cooking, especially his cookies.

[Hinaichi](https://anilist.co/character/217145/Hinaichi)'s subordinate. A dhampir and former high school classmate of [Ronaldo](https://anilist.co/character/195178/Ronaldo)'s. As a mama's boy, he hates that his vampire mother is a fan of Ronaldo's books and seeks to show her a less desirable side of the hunter. His hatred borders on obsession, his room decorated with Ronaldo posters and merchandise.
A busty hunter dressed as a nun from [Ronaldo](https://anilist.co/character/195178/Ronaldo)'s  guild whose main job is being a Matagi, hunting bears.

A vampire hunter from [Ronaldo](https://anilist.co/character/195178/Ronaldo)'s guild with metal armor on his left arm. A reformed delinquent, he keeps his composure under most situations but his past will surface if he's angered.
Another hunter from [Ronaldo](https://anilist.co/character/195178/Ronaldo)'s guild. He has a fetish for girls with body hair. He wears a vaguely American Southwestern style outfit.
The captain of the Vampire Control Division and [Ronaldo](https://anilist.co/character/195178/Ronaldo)'s older brother. He used to be a hunter.

[Ronaldo](https://anilist.co/character/195178/Ronaldo)'s editor from Autumn Books. A terrifyingly calm man who wields a battleaxe, as all employees of Autumn Books do. He loves cats more than meeting deadlines.
Normal cat living in the neighborhood ~!However, in reality, he is a blood-sucking cat that manipulates people with his hypnotic ability.!~
